t: You're at 90 to 94 Fleet Street, in the City of London. It was designed by Herbert Huntly-Gordon, a British architect who lived from 1864 to 1926. Fleet Street is a busy road, so it's worth pausing to look up above the shopfronts at the upper floors, where a building's design usually shows. That's all I can say with confidence about this one, so I'll leave you to look at it and decide what you make of it.
